title: Melco Resorts Philippines Foundation donates P24.8M to equip new Philippine Red Cross Center
summary: Melco Resorts (Philippines) Foundation continues its support for the Philippine Red Cross (PRC) with a P24.8 million donation of medical and non-medical equipment for the new PRC Cavite Chapter…

blocks.text: Melco Resorts (Philippines) Foundation continues its support for the Philippine Red Cross (PRC) with a P24.8 million donation of medical and non-medical equipment for the new PRC Cavite Chapter headquarters and Provincial Blood Center at the Vermosa Complex in Imus, Cavite. The Foundation is the charitable arm of City of Dreams Manila. Clarence Chung, Chairman
